name: Pumice the Moon-Dust Cat
blurb: Pumice, a pale ash-grey shorthair with honey-gold eyes, rolls in the dry garden path and leaves soft grey paw prints on every stone.

name: Plume the Liftoff Cat
blurb: Plume, a white cat with a smoky grey back and copper eyes, shoots straight up the garden tree whenever someone counts down from ten.

name: Crater the Moon-Spotted Cat
blurb: Crater, a silver spotted tabby with round charcoal spots and green eyes, naps in the sandbox all day and sits up tall at moonrise.
